title: Fittonia Nerve Plant- Mini Plug Plants - 2x - Perfect For a Vivarium
description:
2x Plug plants

 Fittonia (Nerve Plant) Plug Plants – Easy Houseplant, Non-Toxic
 


 Care Level: Moderate
 

 Light: Prefers bright, indirect light. Avoid direct sun, which can scorch leaves.
 

 Watering: Allow the top 2 inches of soil to dry before watering thoroughly. Avoid overwatering and ensure the pot has drainage holes. If the plant wilts, it usually recovers quickly after watering.
 

 Humidity: Thrives in humid environments—ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, or terrariums. Mist regularly if air is dry. Low humidity may cause leaf tips to brown.
 

 Feeding: Feed once or twice a month during spring and summer. No feeding needed in winter.
 

 Repotting: Repot every 2 years or when root bound. Can be divided during repotting for propagation.
 

 Toxicity: Non-toxic to humans and pets.
